name: gitforage
description: Prior-art and duplicate-work research skill for registries, issues, pull requests, and open-source project analysis.

interface.longDescription: A reusable workflow for checking package registries, open issues, pull requests, and GitHub repositories before building new tools, plugins, libraries, integrations, or major features.
defaultPrompt: Use Git Forage before we build this feature.
Search for prior art and open PRs for this idea.
Find maintained open-source projects that solve this problem.
